answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 31807 Country: India Title: Diabeties and Fast Question: What is the orders of shariah about fasting to Blood sugar patient Answer ID: 31807 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 684/574/B=1432) If he feels unbearable pain in keeping the fast, he is allowed to leave the fast. If he is able to make up the missed fasts he should do so, otherwise he should pay fidya (expiation) for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
